summary: Full test of new sales_manager role feature. Backend: 15/15 tests pass in /app/backend/tests/test_sales_manager_feature.py covering report shape, assigned-stamp filtering, date-window enforcement (out-of-range/future/inverted), role gates (exec 403, SM 200 on polythene/stock-entry, SM 403 on manager approvals + all-entries), math parity with admin sales-report, admin CRUD for sales_manager role, and no_stamps_assigned=true empty-response path. Frontend: TEST_SM login auto-redirects to /manager-sales; 3 assigned-stamp chips (STAMP 5, STAMP 7, Unassigned) render; Last Month period button loads July 2026 data (totals 1096.830 kg gross / 937.167 kg net, 253 item rows, 1 stamp row 'Unassigned'); By Stamp/By Item tabs switch correctly; sort-name toggles alphabetical order (first row changes CHAIN MS-70 -> .CHAIN -058); sort-net puts heaviest first; custom July range works; setting start=2026-01-01 (before earliest 2026-06-06) shows error toast 'Only the last 2 months are viewable (2026-06-06 to 2026-08-05)' and NO API request fires; /executive-entry and /polythene-management load for SM (polythene has 0 delete buttons — read-only); admin /stamp-assignments dropdown lists ONLY 'SMANAGER (Manager)' and 'TEST_SM (Sales Manager)' — no admin or TEST_EXEC; admin /sales-report regression page loads normally.
critical_code_review_comments: get_sales_manager_report resolves stamp via stamp_lookup[leader] — correct; also excludes items with numeric-only names and the EXCLUDED set consistent with sales-report; the earliest_allowed = min(today-60d, first_prev_month) matches spec (extends to full previous month).
Role validation in POST /api/users/create and PUT /api/users/{username} correctly includes 'sales_manager'; user creation API requires 'full_name' (not 'name') — worth documenting for API consumers.
seed_data_creation: Created + deleted throwaway users TMP_SM_TEST, TMP_SM_UPD, TMP_SM_NOSTAMP (all cleaned up in test teardown). TEST_SM stamp assignments left untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new sales_manager feature acceptance criteria pass. Backend suite at /app/backend/tests/test_sales_manager_feature.py is reusable for regression. Frontend testids present and working: manager-sales-page, assigned-stamp-chip-*, period-last-month/this-month, custom-start-date/custom-end-date/custom-apply-btn, sort-name/sort-gross/sort-net, sales-row-{i}, sales-view-tab-item/stamp, total-gross/total-net, assign-user-select. Note recharts warnings (chart container width/height -1) appear on sales-report page but do not break functionality.
